# Tensile test elastic modulus estimates

## Method

Stress was regressed linearly on strain for each material, pooling all 30 measurements (three specimens, ten strain levels each). The elastic modulus is the fitted slope; the intercept was allowed to vary. Fits cover the measured strain range of 0.0002–0.0020. Specimen-to-specimen spread below is the sample standard deviation of the three individual specimen slopes.

## Results

| Material | Modulus (GPa) | Intercept (MPa) | R² | Specimen slope mean ± SD (GPa) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| aluminum | 69.38 | -0.31 | 0.9983 | 69.38 ± 1.76 |
| steel | 199.06 | 0.62 | 0.9984 | 199.06 ± 2.00 |
| titanium | 116.56 | -0.77 | 0.9979 | 116.56 ± 1.71 |

## Figure

![Stress–strain measurements and pooled linear fits](stress_strain_fits.png)

Points show individual measurements, colored by material; lines show the pooled linear fits. These are apparent slopes over the tested range, so any yielding or toe-region behavior within that range can affect the estimates.

item.text:
